'''Zorrock''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Rizzler]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Phantothief]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Zorrock is no lowly thief, but a con artist who plans out the perfect style, timing, and escape route. The moment people notice something's gone missing-that's when Zorrock makes a dramatic entrance up high, leaving onlookers stunned before disappearing without a trace."

Zorrock is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A brown raccoon that wears a blue eye mask and cape. It stands bipedal and has off-white, orange, and red accents in its fur. It also has blue fur around its neck and at the end of its large, striped tail.

Zorrock's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes instances of blue to green.

== Evolution Trial ==
Zorrock's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Phantothief]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (Dig up treasure x120) or [[Cozy Farm]] (Use Fertilizer x7200).
* Obtain 15 more Glitter Fruit. Time for a glow-up!

== Trivia ==
* Zorrock and its evolutions were added to the game on 9/8/2026 alongside [[Blechlama]] and [[Morphanessa]].
